metadata.title: PLA Leadership Observatory
metadata.editorialNote: A position-first leadership observatory. A fixed archetype of senior positions defines what is covered and what is a gap; the adverse ledger records last appearance, first signal and formal action for every removed officer; narrow trackers measure one question each from bounded official sources. No promotion probabilities are published.

adverse.formerRole: First vice chairman, Central Military Commission
adverse.summary: The Party announced an investigation for suspected serious disciplinary and legal violations on 24 January 2026; the NPC Standing Committee then removed him as state CMC vice chairman and his NPC seat was terminated on 28 August. His parallel Party-CMC title had not been separately disposed of in a public Central Committee notice by the cutoff, but he is operationally inactive and not a promotion prospect.

lastPublicAppearance.event: At the CMC ceremony promoting officers to the rank of general at the Bayi Building in Beijing, attended by Xi Jinping, Zhang Youxia read out the promotion order signed by Xi and joined the group photo with the newly promoted generals.
lastPublicAppearance.titleZh: 中央军委副主席张又侠
lastPublicAppearance.publisher: Xinhua (news.cn)
lastPublicAppearance.note: Xinhua text (reporter 梅常伟, dated 北京12月22日电) fetched and read: '中央军委副主席张又侠宣读中央军委主席习近平签署的晋升上将军衔命令'. Same report carried by People's Daily (cpc.people.com.cn/n1/2025/1223/c64094-40630047.html, fetched) and CCTV. No later appearance found: searches of news.cn, 81.cn (PLA Daily PDFs 2025-12-31 and 2026-01-05 checked, no mention) and general Chinese/English queries for 23 Dec 2025 to 19 Jan 2026 returned nothing naming him; CNA (2026-01-21) and Epoch Times (2026-01-22) both state 22 Dec 2025 was his last public appearance. This source does not establish that no non-reported appearance occurred; the 31 Dec 2025 CPPCC New Year tea reception reports name only Politburo Standing Committee members, so cannot be used.

firstConcreteSignal.event: CNA (Central News Agency, Taiwan) reported that CCTV footage of the 20 January 2026 opening of the provincial/ministerial-level seminar on the Fourth Plenum showed Zhang Youxia's front-row Politburo seat empty (Zhang Shengmin sat in the front row instead) and that Liu Zhenli was also absent; both were noted as last seen at the 22 Dec 2025 promotion ceremony.
firstConcreteSignal.note: Earlier than the seeded 24 Jan 2026 MND/Xinhua investigation notice (which remains the official first signal and should be kept as an intermediate/official item). Even earlier same-day reporting exists from Epoch Times (2026-01-20, https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/26/1/20/n14680088.htm, fetched; class C) and Wenxuecity (2026-01-21). The CCTV Xinwen Lianbo broadcast of 2026-01-20 itself is the underlying primary evidence but is not an easily citable dated page; absence continued at the 23 Jan closing ceremony (Epoch Times 2026-01-23).

formalAction.note: NPC Standing Committee removed him as state CMC vice chairman and terminated his NPC seat on 28 August 2026

Earliest dated public signal is media noting his absence from the 20 Jan 2026 seminar opening (Epoch Times 20 Jan, C-class; CNA 21 Jan, B-class); the seeded 24 Jan official notice remains the official first signal. Seeded formalAction URL is correct for the state CMC removal but the NPC-seat termination it describes is documented in the separate 公告〔十四届〕第十九号 (URL given in seededUrlChecks).

Later official-media namings exist but WITHOUT a title: People's Daily 2023-03-06 p1 '十四届全国人大一次会议在京开幕' lists 魏凤和 among '在主席台就座的还有' (2023-03-05), and People's Daily 2023-03-14 p1 '十四届全国人大一次会议在京闭幕' lists him again on the rostrum among outgoing leaders (2023-03-13, http://paper.people.com.cn/rmrb/html/2023-03/14/nw.D110000renmrb_20230314_1-01.htm) - his last official-media appearance before retirement. Caveat: only People's Daily print headline scans (pages 1-8, 2023-01-01..03-13) and CCTV 新闻联播 titles (Feb-Mar 2023) were searchable; a titled MND/军事报道 item from Jan-Mar 2023 could exist but was not found (mod.gov.cn archives online go back only to mid-2024).

firstConcreteSignal.event: At the MND regular press conference of 31 Aug 2023, a reporter asked about Rocket Force leadership changes and the whereabouts of former defence minister Wei Fenghe; spokesman 吴谦 replied '有案必查，有腐必惩'. Reuters reported it the same day; VOA Chinese and RFA carried it on 2023-09-01
firstConcreteSignal.publisher: VOA Chinese (美国之音), citing Reuters
firstConcreteSignal.note: Seed was null. VOA page (dated 2023年9月1日, URL slug 20230831) fetched: '中国国防部星期四(8月31日)在被问到火箭军高层人事变更以及前国防部长魏凤和消失数月时誓言...有案必查，有腐必惩'. Corroborated by RFA 2023-09-01 https://www.rfa.org/mandarin/Xinwen/9-09012023161655.html (fetched). Reuters original https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-defence-ministry-we-will-crack-down-every-corrupt-official-2023-08-31/ returns 401 via proxy; MND's own transcript is not in its online archive (list only reaches mid-2024). Later signals: absent from the 2023-09-28 National Day reception - People's Daily 2023-09-29 p1 attendance list fetched and contains no 魏凤和 while listing 迟浩田 etc.; noted by 星岛/CNA 2023-09-30 https://www.cna.com.tw/news/acn/202309300127.aspx (fetched); omitted from the 2024-02-07 Xinhua pre-Spring Festival 看望老同志 list (RFI 2024-02-07, not fetchable, 403). The 2024-06-27 notice states the CMC investigation was opened 2023-09-21.

timeline.researchNotes: Wei retired at the 14th NPC (12 Mar 2023). His last TITLED official-media appearance found is 2023-01-06 (People's Daily 2023-01-07: 国务委员兼国防部长魏凤和会见土库曼斯坦国防部长); the last official-media naming of any kind before retirement is the 2023-03-13 NPC closing rostrum list (untitled). Confidence is medium because only headline-level scans of People's Daily and CCTV were possible; MND-site items (魏凤和会见/通话) from Jan-Mar 2023 may exist but the MND archive no longer serves 2023 content and Xinhua search is blocked. First public signal set to the 2023-08-31 MND press-conference question about his whereabouts (Reuters, via VOA/RFA, B2); the officially stated investigation date is 2023-09-21 (disclosed only 2024-06-27); 2023-09-28 National Day reception absence is confirmed from the People's Daily attendance list. Seed formalAction (A1 Xinhua 2024-06-27) unchanged; note the 2026-05-07 military court sentence (Xinhua https://www.news.cn/20260507/d68c97ec93444f62afb67f849c084bf3/c.html, cited by Wikipedia) as a later action.

lastPublicAppearance.titleZh: 中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长
lastPublicAppearance.publisher: 新华社 (Xinhua text reprinted by 人民网 world.people.com.cn; 来源：新华网)
lastPublicAppearance.note: Page text read (GBK-decoded): '11日中午，中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长张振中中将在香格里拉对话会期间的吹风会上正告美方'. Same appearance independently confirmed by Caixin 2022-06-13 (https://china.caixin.com/2022-06-13/101898188.html, calls it his first appearance in the new post) and China Daily EN 2022-06-12/13. A second Xinhua piece (2022-06-13, http://world.people.com.cn/n1/2022/0613/c1002-32444990.html) quotes him with the same title but reports the 12 June closing day, so the last safely datable titled appearance is 2022-06-11. Caveat: this is 13 months before the 2023-07-07 removal. I found NO dated, titled appearance between 2022-06-12 and 2023-07-07 in any reachable index: people.cn search (all 29 hits for 张振中 reviewed), CCTV search (latest military hit 2022-06-15), China Daily EN search, zh-Wikipedia full-text, and the MOD/81.cn site-search API (mod-search.mod.gov.cn / mil-search.81.cn), whose index only covers the post-migration site (late 2023 onward) and therefore cannot see 2022–2023 MOD 会见 items. He is named without title in the 14th NPC deputy list (Xinhua 2023-02-24, http://www.xinhuanet.com/2023-02/25/c_1129395721.htm, name confirmed in page) and presumably attended the March 2023 NPC session, but no titled report of that was found. Plausibly later MOD/81.cn meeting reports exist in the un-indexed old-site archive.

firstConcreteSignal.event: South China Morning Post report (relayed the same day by Lianhe Zaobao) that CMC discipline inspectors and military auditors were investigating Rocket Force commander Li Yuchao, deputy commander Liu Guangbin and former deputy commander Zhang Zhenzhong, and that the three had been taken away
firstConcreteSignal.publisher: 联合早报 (Lianhe Zaobao), citing 南华早报 (SCMP) of 2023-07-28
firstConcreteSignal.note: Zaobao page fetched live; it is dated 2023年7月28日 20:42 and names 张振中 as 前副司令员 taken away by CMC anti-corruption investigators, citing SCMP's report of the same day. The SCMP original URL was not retrieved (SCMP search is JS-only), hence the relay is cited. This is the first public dated signal; the actual removal (联合参谋部军人代表大会 罢免 on 2023-07-07, per the 代表资格审查委员会报告 adopted 2023-12-29, read on zh.wikisource) was not made public until the 2023-12-29 NPCSC announcement. Successor 曹青锋 was reported as JSD deputy chief on 2023-12-25 (sina, cited by zh-Wikipedia, not fetched) — later than this signal. The EDD's 2023-07-26 procurement-irregularities notice did not name him.

positionTiers.label: Central Military Commission and Ministry of National Defense
positionTiers.plain: The top of the system: the chairman, vice chairmen and ordinary members of the Party's military commission, plus the defense minister, who is a state official rather than a commander.

positionTiers.label: CMC organs
positionTiers.plain: The fifteen departments, commissions and offices that work directly for the commission, plus the joint operations command centre and the central guard bureau.

positionTiers.label: Theater commands
positionTiers.plain: The five joint theater commands. Each has a commander, a political commissar, a chief of staff and a political-work director, and a service component for the Army, Navy and Air Force where one exists.

positionTiers.label: Services
positionTiers.plain: The Army, Navy, Air Force and Rocket Force headquarters: commander, political commissar, chief of staff, political-work director, discipline secretary, and the deputies bench.

positionTiers.label: Rocket Force bases
positionTiers.plain: The nine numbered Rocket Force bases (61 to 69). These are the missile force's operational and support formations and are almost entirely invisible in public sources after the purge.

positionTiers.label: Arms
positionTiers.plain: The four arms created or reorganized in 2024: Aerospace Force, Cyberspace Force, Information Support Force and Joint Logistic Support Force.

positionTiers.label: People's Armed Police, Coast Guard and key garrisons
positionTiers.labelZh: 武警 / 海警 / 重点军区
positionTiers.plain: The paramilitary police and coast guard headquarters, and the three ground-force districts that matter most for the capital and the western frontier.

positionTiers.label: Group armies
positionTiers.plain: The thirteen numbered group armies (71st to 83rd), the corps-level commands that feed theater and Army leadership.

positionTiers.label: Academies and research
positionTiers.plain: The three central academies and the service universities. Leadership here is well documented on institution websites but is a training ecosystem, not a command ladder.

gaps: 2022-09-08 (王强): the Xinhua politics/leaders page is a photo item whose caption names 北部战区司令员王强; the full dispatch text (上午11时许, 许其亮宣读, 张又侠主持) was only seen in a search snippet of the Xinhua Daily Telegraph reprint. news.cn/mrdx/2022-09/09/c_1310660867.htm now redirects to mrdx.cn; paper.people.com.cn 2022-09-09 returned 403; stcn.com reprint failed via proxy (502).

2021-09-06: the Xinhua URL found (c_1127833663) is the photo page; the five names were confirmed from the People's Daily reprint of the same 新华社 dispatch (politics.people.com.cn/n1/2021/0907/c1024-32219362.html). A text-version Xinhua URL was not located before the WebSearch budget ran out.

Billet-newness judgments rely on zh.wikipedia career chronologies (secondary) plus same-day/next-day commentary (新京报 2021-09-06, 南方都市报 2022-01-22, 政知见 2023-06-29 and 2023-12-26, 财新 2026-07-03). No official '由...调任' language exists in the Xinhua ceremony reports themselves. Officers flagged as most uncertain: 王春宁 (Wikipedia gives no explicit PAP commander appointment month), 许学强 (Wikipedia disambiguation page; relies on 新京报 statement that all five billets were first disclosed), 何宏军 (常务副主任 designation new, but deputy director since 2019), 王刚 (Wikipedia says 空军司令员 from 2025-12 but page is marked thinly sourced).

No ceremony found for calendar 2025 before 2025-12-22, and none in 2026 other than 2026-07-03 through the 2026-09-02 cutoff. The china-cdt.com item filed under '2025/4' is a reprint of the 2023-12-25 report (王文全/胡中明); the site returned 504 so this rests on the search snippet.

No ceremonies found in 2022 other than 2022-01-21 and 2022-09-08, in 2020 other than 2020-07-29 and 2020-12-18, and in 2021 other than 2021-07-05 and 2021-09-06; 2023 had four (Jan 18, Jun 28, Jul 31, Dec 25) per 政知见's own count, and 2024 three (Mar 28, Jul 9, Dec 23). Exhaustiveness beyond these rests on year-by-year searches; the session's WebSearch quota (200) was exhausted at the end, so no further sweep was possible.
2020-12-18 Xinhua page cites 来源 新华社'新华视点'微博 rather than a dated 新华社北京电 line; content otherwise standard.

laterChanges.event: Second Plenum communiqué (二十届二中全会, 2023-02-26 to 28): no expulsions, no vacancy filling. Attendance line records 候补中央委员170人. Personnel content limited to state/CPPCC leadership nominations and the 党和国家机构改革方案.

Politburo meeting adopted the CMC report on 李尚福 and decided to expel him from the Party (开除党籍) and terminate his 20th Congress delegate status; the CMC had earlier expelled him from the military and cancelled his 陆军上将 rank; expulsion 'to be confirmed at a plenum'. (Xinhua item on 李尚福 fetched; the companion 李玉超 item was not fetched — his expulsion is documented in the Third Plenum communiqué.)

Third Plenum communiqué: '全会审议并通过了中共中央军事委员会关于李尚福、李玉超、孙金明严重违纪违法问题的审查报告，确认中央政治局之前作出的给予李尚福、李玉超、孙金明开除党籍的处分' (李尚福, 李玉超 full members; 孙金明 alternate #49). Vacancies filled: '决定递补中央委员会候补委员丁向群、于立军、于吉红为中央委员会委员' (ordinals #1, #3, #4). Passed over: 丁兴农 (#2, 火箭军副政委, the highest-ranked military alternate). Also accepted 秦刚's resignation (civilian).

Party Centre decision (announced 2025-10-17 by the MND; read here in the 解放军报社论 carried by Xinhua 2025-10-18): '党中央决定，给予何卫东、苗华、何宏军、王秀斌、林向阳、秦树桐、袁华智、王厚斌、王春宁等9人开除党籍处分，将涉嫌犯罪问题移送军事检察机关依法审查起诉'. Eight of the nine are 20th CC full members; 王厚斌 (火箭军司令员) is not a CC member.

Fourth Plenum communiqué: adopted the CMC report on 何卫东、苗华、何宏军、王秀斌、林向阳、秦树桐、袁华智、王春宁、张凤中 and confirmed the Politburo's expulsions of those nine military members (eight full members plus alternate 张凤中 #83) together with civilians 唐仁健、金湘军、李石松、杨发森、朱芝松. Vacancies filled: '决定递补中央委员会候补委员于会文、马汉成、王健、王曦、王永红、王庭凯、王新伟、韦韬、邓亦武、邓修明、卢红为中央委员会委员' (ordinals #5, #6, #7, #8, #10, #12, #13, #15, #18, #19, #22). Military alternates ranked above #22 and passed over: 丁兴农 (#2), 王立岩 (#9), 王抗平 (#11), 方永祥 (#16), 石正露 (#21); civilians passed over in the same range: 王嘉毅 (#14), 方红卫 (#17), 石玉钢 (#20).
NPC Standing Committee 18th session (state, not Party, action): '决定任命张升民为中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席，免去何卫东的中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席职务'.

MND notice: '中央政治局委员、中央军委副主席张又侠，中央军委委员、中央军委联合参谋部参谋长刘振立涉嫌严重违纪违法，经党中央研究，决定对张又侠、刘振立立案审查调查'. No plenum action yet; the Fifth Plenum is scheduled for October 2026 (zh.wikipedia 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会 citing 12371.cn, 2026-08-01).

gaps: The news.cn full-member list URL was not located: https://www.news.cn/2022-10/22/c_1129075009.htm (given in the brief as the full list) is the 候补委员 list; c_1129075005–1129075011 and the /politics/cpc20/ variants return 404. The 205-name list was read from the gov.cn reprint (来源：新华社, content_5720882.htm), which is textually the Xinhua dispatch.

Position at election could not be dated from an official or article source for: 赵晓哲 (army-level 主任 of 军委科技委; article only gives 副主任 from 2018-06), 周志鑫 (军委科技委副主任), 傅爱国 (国防科技大学政委), 魏文徽 (南部战区副司令员), 孙向东 (空降兵军军长), 黄旭聪 (74集团军军长) — their zh.wikipedia articles are stubs, so the billet rests on the Wikipedia list-row annotation (secondary_source_only).
何卫东's billet between leaving 东部战区司令员 (2022-01) and election as CMC vice chairman (2022-10-23) was never published; recorded as CMC vice chairman with the pre-Congress gap noted.

刘振立: his article's infobox dates the 联合参谋部参谋长 appointment to 2022-09 while the body says 2023-03; recorded per infobox and the 陆军司令员 handover to 李桥铭 (2022-09). 许学强's 装备发展部部长 appointment was disclosed only after the Congress (李尚福 held it to 2022-11-08), so he is recorded as 国防大学校长 at election.
杨志亮: the Wikipedia row gives 南部战区副政治委员兼南部战区海军政治委员 but the article dates only 南部战区海军政治委员 (2019-12); the 副政治委员 date is unverified.

Separate Xinhua items for the Politburo expulsions of 李玉超 (June 2024) and 张凤中 (2025) were not fetched; both expulsions are documented only through the plenum communiqués here. The 2025-10-17 MND announcement itself (mod.gov.cn) was not fetched; the Xinhua-carried 解放军报社论 of 2025-10-18 quoting the Party Centre decision was used instead.

Wikipedia list-page status annotations (被查 / NPC deputy revocations for 王鹏, 王仁华, 张林, 张红兵, 李伟, 李桥铭, 许学强, 李凤彪, 郭普校, 巨乾生, 钟绍军, 赵晓哲, 王抗平) are recorded in notes as secondary only; their official NPC dates belong to research/trackers/npc-terminations.json and were not re-verified here. ccdi.gov.cn citations on the Wikipedia pages were not fetched (unreachable per brief).

No plenum between the Fourth Plenum (2025-10-23) and the 2026-09-03 cutoff: the Politburo expulsion of 马兴瑞 (civilian, 2026-07-14, Xinhua) explicitly awaits plenum confirmation, and the Wikipedia CC20 article dates the Fifth Plenum to October 2026. Expulsions of civilians 蓝天立, 王莉霞, 易会满, 马兴瑞 (2026) are therefore pending and outside this lane.

Military membership count: 44 full members (of 205) and 22 alternates (of 171), identified from rank annotations in the Wikipedia tables. Anyone the Wikipedia editors did not annotate with a rank would have been missed; the 205-name list was scanned for other obviously military names and none were found.

reviewLog.concern: Analysis prose was gnomic: individually correct statements phrased so that only a specialist could follow them.
reviewLog.response: Every judgment, research question, rule and heading now leads with a plain-English statement and, where a claim is made, one dated example from the dataset. The precise formulation is kept as a second line. A glossary defines every term of art, and a release test fails the build if a headline uses an undefined term, probability notation or a slogan contrast.
changed: app/data/assessment.ts (plain and example fields on every headline record)
Glossary section and inline term definitions
notChanged: The documentary layer (officers, claims, sources) and its role-state vocabulary, which are already defined in the data dictionary

reviewLog.concern: The site did not state how the data was collected or categorized, so a reader could not tell what was important from what was a gap.
reviewLog.response: The collection unit is now a position. A fixed archetype of 156 principal seats and 23 bench slots across nine tiers defines the universe; every officer is mapped to a seat as holder or handler, or listed as outside the archetype with a stated reason; every seat shows its coverage state, including 'no record'. The method, the sources actually swept, and the parts that are not reproducible from this repository are written down in docs/COLLECTION_METHOD.md and on the Method tab.
notChanged: The upstream research_v2 extraction remains outside the repository; the boundary is stated, not hidden

reviewLog.concern: The research questions needed expert honing, and the headline judgment rested on a premise the reviewer judged irrelevant: that the 2026 senior-cadre training course is a hidden political re-certification gate. Products built by language models recover badly from a flawed premise.
reviewLog.response: The re-certification premise is retired and recorded in a premise register with its status, where it was used, and the test that would revive it. The headline judgment is now derived from counts in the position board. The numeric Structural Promotion Index and its succession boards, which rested on analyst-assigned ranges with no calibration, are dropped; the empirical route evidence is kept without scores. Research questions are rewritten so each names the artifact that answers it; the eligible-loser question leads and the course-roster question is gone.
changed: Dropped: succession boards, score model, selection regimes and scenarios, task–leader fit, causal chains, indicator engine, behavior grades, network motifs, technical-authority cases, system fitness, collection portfolio
notChanged: The course and supervision-measure sources stay in the system-source list as context; the documentary claims about them were accurate

reviewLog.concern: Narrower, measurable goals would work better; for the corruption ledger, identify the last publicized appearance before a target disappears and measure the time to the first concrete sign of trouble.
reviewLog.response: The adverse ledger now carries a disappearance clock for every record: last titled public appearance, first concrete public signal, formal action, and the day counts between them, with a collection state and a search lane where a date is still missing. Five further trackers were added on the same principle, each answering one question from a bounded set of official sources: NPC military-delegate terminations, full-general promotion ceremonies, the 20th Central Committee military cohort, high-expectancy event attendance, and principal-seat turnovers, plus a title-freshness monitor computed from the existing data.
notChanged: Records without a verified date stay null; nothing is inferred to fill a cell
